dedupe_keys.name: data on intermodal rail connections in europe

description: Data on intermodal rail connections in Europe is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Mobilithek. This dataset contains information about intermodal rail connections in Europe. Covered are 17 countries with a 1,435 mm rail network. Included are: Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Germany, Poland, Czech Republic, Slovakia, Hungary, Slovenia, Croatia, Italy, Austria, Switzerland, France, Luxembourg, Belgium and the Netherlands. Coverage: Mobilithek. The portal files it under the publisher Mobilithek. Its tags are intermodaler-transport. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/BIN, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/CSV. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
